# Progressive overload

Increase weekly training volume gradually. A common starting point is to add one set per muscle group per week while sleep and soreness stay acceptable.

# Deload

A deload week reduces volume by roughly forty percent. Keep the movements and lower the sets.

# Protein sources

Tofu provides plant protein and is suitable for people who avoid meat.

# Protein timing

Distributing protein across three or four meals is generally easier to follow than concentrating it in one meal.

# Protein and training

Resistance training increases the value of adequate protein intake for preserving lean mass.

# Version marker

This document says alpha for the replacement test.

# Second block

The second block also says alpha.

# Weekly frequency

Three full-body sessions per week are sufficient for a beginner who is new to resistance training.

# Weekly frequency

Four sessions per week allow more practice and may suit someone with prior training experience, but require adequate recovery.

# Hydration

Drink water across the day rather than only around training.
